definition.prompt: Build Folding Map as an original zero-dependency component. Match v4 Figma 161:932 in the native thumbnail, using the unchanged supplied SVGs in their exact original sizes and slots. Keep all four complete original route segments, place names, coordinates, compass and metrics in full. Native shows four exact40x92 dark panels, with the unchanged141.8x37.8002 orange SVG clipped across them. Preserve alternating87/-88/88/-88-degree folds and0.45 one-shot visibility semantics, user override and permanent idle cancellation. Use400ms opening/250ms closing,40ms forward/reverse stagger, and retarget from actual visible angles. Keep the original3600ms alternating2.2-degree idle model; reduced motion uses a still frame and150ms opacity. Use shared dock actions, original local portable assets, native keyboard/touch, optical full typography >=11px at360px, caller/viewport holds, deferred held intent and complete observer/frame cleanup.

definition.prompt: Build an original Draggable Cards in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript without runtime dependencies. Throw three approved photo cards with carried velocity and rotation. Double-click or use Restack to return every card to its original arrangement. Match Figma Stage 145:1538 and all 11 native layers, 1 supplied SVG slots and 3 exact approved v2 photo slots. Keep unchanged SVG bytes, root dimensions and offsets, original reference copy, the complete full model and local datasets. Native retains its exact 372×264 reference composition inside the shared fitted Stage; full uses a 640×520 plane. The shell owns replay, pause and outer chrome. Preserve native keyboard/touch, independent caller/document/viewport holds, queued intent, interruption, capture cleanup, reduced 150ms inert old-paint fades, at least 11px rendered type and complete portable exports. Photo previews retain original approved 800/1600px hashes and attribution; portable exports use the licensed 800px files. Pro candidates stay free until the owner chooses the seams flag. Keep all three unchanged native photo cards: aurora 104×136 at (70,52), forestBlue 104×136 at (198,52), cityTeal 116×152 at (128,30), frontmost last; retain the supplied cursor. Full retains Northern lights, Blue forest and City after dark, all three approved photographs and original 800/1600px hashes/credits. Follow real scaled mouse/touch immediately, carry recent measured release velocity into analytical 380/32/1 X/Y and angular springs, keep rotated corners within the desk, and rubber-band overshoot at 0.55. Lost capture rolls back the captured pose. Frozen gestures cannot invent release velocity. Arrow keys move the focused card; double-click, Home and the shared Restack action restore all three original poses and retire capture. Accessibility: expose the component-local content without document-level landmarks; use valid named control roles and the complete list, row and cell ownership for this composition. Preserve all visible copy, native geometry, supplied assets, datasets, interaction models and motion recipes.
